name: Christmas in the Backyard at Fathom Church
address: 12700 Old St. Augustine Road, Jacksonville, FL 32258
paras: Fathom Church hosts Christmas in the Backyard on Friday, December 4, 2026 from 6 to 8:30 PM at 12700 Old St. Augustine Road. The church calls it a free community event to kick off the Christmas season with a family friendly evening.
Activities listed on the church page are photos with Santa, a family photo booth, pizza, a treats and cocoa bar, an outdoor movie with popcorn, a snow machine and kids' crafts and activities.
Space is limited, so the church asks families to pre-register for a free ticket. Each ticket includes a pizza and drink dinner plate.
The church invites guests to wear an ugly or cute Christmas sweater, reindeer antlers or a light-up necklace. A Portuguese language registration page is also linked from the church site.

name: Walk Through Bethlehem at East Pointe Church
when_note: Friday and Saturday, December 4, 5, 11 and 12, 6 to 9 PM nightly
paras: East Pointe Church presents Walk Through Bethlehem, a guided tour through the streets of Bethlehem on the night Jesus was born. The church describes it as an immersive experience for the entire family.
The event runs 6 to 9 PM nightly over two weekends, Friday December 4 and Saturday December 5, then Friday December 11 and Saturday December 12. This is the fourth year of the event.
The event page promises live animals and performances, and says it is open to everyone. Worship music plays while groups wait, according to guest reviews on the site.
Tickets are free and are claimed online through the church ticket page. The church lists its address as 270 Kernan Blvd N, Jacksonville, FL 32225.

name: Christmas Over Jacksonville at First Baptist Church
venue: First Baptist Church Downtown campus rooftop
when_note: Sunday, December 6, 6 to 9 PM, following the 5 PM Kids Concert
paras: First Baptist Church Jacksonville holds Christmas Over Jacksonville on Sunday, December 6, 2026 from 6 to 9 PM at its Downtown campus, 125 W Ashley St. The church sets the event on the rooftop overlooking the city.
The church lists live music, horse-drawn hayrides, holiday treats and a live nativity. It also lists dazzling light displays and festive photo opportunities.
The event follows First Kids Worship's Christmas concert, A Night of Faith: Let Your Light Shine, which starts at 5 PM the same day at the Downtown campus.
The registration form on the church event page shows a $0.00 total and asks for a login to register.

name: Riverside Avondale Luminaria
address: Historic Riverside and Avondale, Jacksonville, FL
paras: Riverside Avondale Preservation holds its 42nd annual Luminaria on Sunday, December 20, 2026. The nonprofit says the Sunday evening event lights the historic Riverside Avondale district by candlelight.
The preservation group's event page lists 5 to 11 PM on December 20. It describes the evening as a neighborhood holiday tradition that brings friends, family and neighbors together.
The group funds more than 5,000 luminary kits to light the 26 public parks in Riverside and Avondale, and also supplies kits to neighborhood churches, community spaces and merchant districts.

The Cummer Museum joins in with live music on its front lawn, warm drinks and seasonal bites from the Cummer Cafe and a festive art making activity for all ages. The museum's galleries and gardens are closed that evening.
